# tcs-source-ingest

Turns the user's raw source material (PDF/Word/PowerPoint/Excel/Markdown/HTML files, folders, web pages, YouTube/Vimeo or local recordings, Drive/OneDrive folders via rclone, pasted text) into a chunked, citable `sources.yaml` with S/F ids, chunk summaries, extracted facts/procedures/definitions and flagged conflicts or outdated items.

Part of the **[Training Content Studio](../../README.md)** plugin. See its "which skill when" guide.

## What it's for
Every later claim in a course must point at a source id. This skill builds that evidence base once, keeps full text in
`cache/` so large sources never have to be re-read, and surfaces contradictions and stale material before scripting.

## When to use it
- Use when someone says "use these documents/this SOP/this video as the source", "ingest", "read my materials", or adds sources to an existing course.
- **Not for:** writing objectives or lessons (tcs-curriculum), narration (tcs-scriptwriter) or checking finished content against sources (tcs-grounding-check).

## Install
```bash
# whole plugin (recommended: scripts use the shared schemas/, kit/, assets/)
git clone https://github.com/TamerElsherif/tamer-skills && claude --plugin-dir tamer-skills/training-content-studio
```
Prerequisites: Python 3.12 venv with `tools/requirements.txt` (plugin root); keys via env or `TCS_ENV_FILE` (`OPENAI_API_KEY` for narration/transcription, `PEXELS_API_KEY` optional); Node 18+ and ffmpeg for video renders.

## How to use
```
/tcs-source-ingest <request or file>
```
**Inputs**

- Any mix of: local files (`.pdf .docx .pptx .xlsx .md .txt .html`), folders, `https://` pages, YouTube/Vimeo links,
  local video/audio (with optional `.vtt/.srt` sidecar), pasted text, `gdrive:` / `onedrive:` rclone paths.
- Run folder `runs/<run>/` (created by tcs-orchestrator) — output goes to `runs/<run>/sources.yaml`.
- Optional: `--authority 1-5` (5 = official policy), `--language`, `--course-id`, existing `sources.yaml` (`--append`).
- Secrets: `OPENAI_API_KEY` (only for whisper transcription) from env or the file in `TCS_ENV_FILE`.

**Outputs**

| File | Content |
|---|---|
| `sources.yaml` | schema `schemas/sources.schema.json`: sources[] with chunks (id, loc, summary, tokens, path), facts[], glossary[], conflicts[] |
| `cache/<Sxx>/<cN>.md` | full text of each chunk (load only what you cite) |
| `cache/candidates.yaml` | deterministic fact candidates per chunk |
| `cache/ingest_report.md` | sources, dates, outdated list, conflicts, skipped inputs + next action |

## Examples
**Example 1: Folder of SOPs**
Prompt: `ingest ./sop/ and this YouTube talk as sources`
Result: Chunks every file/transcript with page/timestamp locations, extracts facts with ids, flags conflicts/outdated items → sources.yaml.

**Example 2: Drive folder**
Prompt: `use my Google Drive folder <link> as the source`
Result: Prints the rclone copy command for your `gdrive:` remote, then ingests the local copy.
